name: The Base Bar
_comment: GDD 22: the branded catalogue (41 bottles; the opening shelf is 6, the other 35 are bought across the counter). Tier 1 is the well; tier 2+ are brand upgrades sold on the end-of-night market. A bottle opens on the rung of the FIRST RECIPE that names its style (2026-08-14): tier 2+ climb the tier/price ladder, tier-1 mixers and juices say their rung out loud in unlockStars. Nothing is quarantined any more - held back is fine, hidden is not, because a bottle the market cannot see is one the shop cannot mention. Charges are per full glass (GDD 21 s4). ABV and origin are display/dialogue only and must never feed scoring.

cards.name: Smirkoff Vodka
cards.blurb: Filters clean. Lifts the evening without asking questions.
cards.art_prompt: a slim clear vodka bottle with a pale blue-grey label band, minimal and cold

cards.name: Garden's Gin
cards.blurb: Juniper-forward. Settles a racing mind, at the cost of a quiet one.
cards.art_prompt: a squat dark green gin bottle with a cream label and a small crest, London dry style

cards.name: White Bat Rum
cards.blurb: Sunlight in a bottle. Wakes people up and warms them through.
cards.art_prompt: a rounded white rum bottle with a coral-pink label and a palm motif

cards.name: John Wanderer Whiskey
cards.blurb: Charred oak and patience. Talks people down off the ledge of a bad day.
cards.art_prompt: a stout amber bourbon bottle with a deep red wax top and a cream label

cards.name: Cumpari Amaro
cards.blurb: Bitter herbs for bitter moods. Meets anger head-on and wins.
cards.art_prompt: a dark brooding Italian amaro bottle with a midnight blue label, gold accents

cards.name: Canzone Vermouth
cards.blurb: Sweet red vermouth. Softens what ended badly.
cards.art_prompt: an elegant red vermouth bottle with a burgundy label and ornate serif frame

cards.name: House Syrup
cards.blurb: Plain sugar, dissolved slow. Comfort by the spoonful.
cards.art_prompt: a small clear glass cruet of simple syrup with a hand-written cream tag

cards.name: Lemonade
cards.blurb: Cuts through the fog. Sharp enough to make some people flinch.
cards.art_prompt: a small glass carafe of fresh lemon juice with a cut lemon beside it

cards.name: Kicker Ginger
cards.blurb: Spiced ginger brew. Puts a spark back in - or a fire, if there was one already.
cards.art_prompt: a cloudy amber ginger beer bottle with a rust-orange label and a ceramic swing top

cards.name: Klara Soda
cards.blurb: Cold, clear, and calming. Waters everything down, on purpose.
cards.art_prompt: a tall clear soda siphon bottle with a pale teal label and rising bubbles

cards.name: Fresh Mint
cards.blurb: A sprig on top. Small, green, and quietly restorative.
cards.art_prompt: a small glass jar of fresh mint sprigs, bright green

cards.name: Luca Olives
cards.blurb: Brined and patient. Takes the edge off an argument.
cards.art_prompt: a small jar of green olives in brine with a rustic olive-branch label

cards.name: Krona Lager
cards.blurb: Cold, plain and honest. The drink people order when they want to stop deciding.
cards.art_prompt: a squat steel beer keg with a pale gold band and a plain enamel label, condensation on the shoulder

cards.name: Goodness Stout
cards.blurb: Black, sweet and filling. Drinks like a meal and settles people down.
cards.art_prompt: a dark iron beer keg with a deep charcoal band and a cream oval label, worn at the rim

cards.name: Brass Pale Ale
cards.blurb: Bitter and bright. The one the regulars argue about.
cards.art_prompt: a copper beer keg with a warm amber band and a marigold-yellow label, brass fittings

cards.name: Absolve Vodka
cards.blurb: Glacier-filtered. The same lift, cleaner and further.
cards.art_prompt: a premium frosted-glass vodka bottle with an ice-white label and silver cap

cards.name: Leafeater Gin
cards.blurb: Navy strength calm. Settles nerves that Boothby cannot reach.
cards.art_prompt: a tall regal gin bottle in deep navy glass with a gold crown on the label

cards.name: Jack Spaniel's Whiskey
cards.blurb: Twelve years in the barrel. Anger does not argue with it.
cards.art_prompt: a heavy-bottomed aged bourbon bottle with a black wax seal and parchment label

cards.name: Jose Cuerdo Tequila
cards.blurb: Blue agave, sun-cured. Turns a quiet table loud.
cards.art_prompt: a tall clear tequila bottle with a woven agave-green label and a rope neck tie

cards.name: Grand Mariner Triple Sec
cards.blurb: Bitter orange peel in silk. The bridge in half the classics.
cards.art_prompt: a squarish orange liqueur bottle with a deep orange label and gold filigree

cards.name: Loca Cola
cards.blurb: Sweet, dark and everywhere. Makes hard liquor easy company.
cards.art_prompt: a classic glass cola bottle with a dark caramel liquid and a ruby-red label

cards.name: Quinn's Tonic

cards.art_prompt: a slender tonic water bottle in pale glass with a duck-egg blue label

cards.name: Blue Ox
cards.blurb: Taurine and bad decisions. Keeps the night going past its bedtime.
cards.art_prompt: a slim energy drink can in electric teal and black with a lightning motif, no text

cards.name: Orange Juice
cards.blurb: Fresh-squeezed sunshine. The soft landing for hard spirits.
cards.art_prompt: a glass carafe of fresh orange juice with a halved orange beside it

cards.name: Limeade
cards.blurb: Sharper than lemon, greener too. The spine of the rum classics.
cards.art_prompt: a small glass carafe of lime juice with cut limes beside it

cards.name: Admiral Morgan Rum
cards.blurb: Barrel-aged in sea air. The warmth stays longer than the glass does.
cards.art_prompt: a squat dark-amber rum bottle with a rope-wrapped neck and a ship motif

cards.name: 1810 Tequila
cards.blurb: Slow-roasted highland agave. Softer going down, louder after.
cards.art_prompt: a tall clear tequila bottle with a deep green agave label and a crescent moon

cards.name: Cranberry
cards.blurb: Tart enough to wake a cocktail up. The pink half of half the classics.
cards.art_prompt: a clear carafe with a crimson blank label and a cork stopper

cards.name: Koala Coffee Liqueur
cards.blurb: Espresso with a passport. Keeps the night going in both directions.
cards.art_prompt: a squat clear bottle with a coffee-brown blank label and a black cap

cards.name: Isla Piña
cards.blurb: Sunshine, pressed. The tiki shelf starts here.
cards.art_prompt: a clear carafe with a sunny-yellow blank label and a pineapple leaf motif

cards.name: Rubis Grenadine
cards.blurb: Pomegranate red that sinks to the bottom and stays there.
cards.art_prompt: a small clear cruet with a ruby blank label band and a silver cap

cards.name: Grey Gander Vodka

cards.art_prompt: an elegant tall crystal vodka bottle with a platinum label and a long neck

cards.name: Hendrake's Gin

cards.art_prompt: a tall dark green gin bottle with a copper botanical engraving and wax seal

cards.art_prompt: a heavy squat whiskey bottle with a charred oak label and a brass cap

cards.name: Krakatoa Rum
cards.blurb: Twenty years in the heat. It came out slower than it went in.
cards.art_prompt: a dark rounded rum bottle with a gold XO crest and a rope-bound neck

cards.name: Don Julep Añejo Tequila

cards.art_prompt: a rounded amber tequila bottle with a hand-painted sun and a cork stopper

cards.name: White Whale Vodka

cards.art_prompt: an ornate crystal vodka bottle with a gilded double-headed crest and frosted facets

cards.name: Gibbon 48 Gin

cards.name: Van Wrinkle 23 Whiskey

cards.art_prompt: a heavy antique whiskey bottle with a cracked oak-brown wax seal and a deep amber glow

cards.name: Maliboo Rum
cards.blurb: Blended from casks that crossed the ocean twice. Tastes of both shores.
cards.art_prompt: a dark green rum bottle with a gold queen-of-the-sea figurehead label and rope filigree

cards.name: Azulejo Tequila

cards.art_prompt: a hand-blown blue-glass tequila bottle with a shattered-sky label and a pewter agave stopper
